name: Defence

levels.note: 10th pass + physical standards. Age 17.5–21 (Agniveer). Physical: running, push-ups, pull-ups.
12th pass with Physics & Maths for NDA/AFCAT (Flying). Age 16.5–19.5 for NDA.
Any degree. SSB interview (5 days). Age 19–25. Height: 157cm (men), 152cm (women).

stages.name: Written Exam
stages.tests: NDA: Maths + GAT (300 marks). CDS: English, GK, Maths. AFCAT: 100 Qs, 2 hrs.
stages.note: Qualifying. Negative marking 1/3. Cut-off varies by academy.

stages.name: SSB Interview (5 days)
stages.tests: Stage 1: OIR + PPDT. Stage 2: Psychology, GTO, Personal Interview, Conference.
stages.note: Only Stage 1 clearers proceed. 5-day process. No coaching substitute for genuine personality.

stages.name: Medical Examination
stages.tests: Full body check: eyes, ears, heart, BMI, chest, joints, dental, blood tests.
stages.note: Strict standards. Colour blindness disqualifies Flying. BMI 18.5–25.

stages.name: Merit List & Joining
stages.tests: All-India merit based on written + SSB. Medical fitness mandatory.
stages.note: Final allotment by academy capacity. Training 1.5–3 years depending on entry.

reality: Agniveer is a 4-year contract. Only 25% are retained for 15 more years. Plan for civilian career after.
NDA requires 12th with Physics & Maths — no exceptions. CDS allows any degree but Maths for Navy/Air Force.
SSB is not about knowledge — it tests personality, OLQs (Officer Like Qualities). 95% fail at SSB.
Medical standards are strict. Flat feet, knock knees, colour blindness = rejection. Get checked before applying.
Paramilitary (BSF, CRPF, CISF) has separate exams via SSC GD. Less competitive than Army/Navy/Air Force.
Physical fitness is non-negotiable. Start running 2km daily, push-ups, pull-ups 6 months before exam.

faq.q: What is Agniveer and how is it different from regular recruitment?
faq.a: Agniveer is a 4-year contract service in all three armed forces. 25% are retained for 15 more years; 75% exit with a Seva Nidhi package. Regular recruitment (NDA, CDS, TGC) leads to permanent commission.

faq.q: Can women join the Indian Army?
faq.a: Yes. Women can join via NDA (from 2022), CDS, TGC, SSC (Tech/Non-Tech), and Agniveer. Combat roles opened for women in Army (2020), Navy and Air Force already had women officers.

Services Selection Board — a 5-day personality and aptitude assessment. Tests Officer Like Qualities (OLQs) through psychology tests, group tasks, and personal interview. No coaching can replace genuine personality development.

faq.q: Is there negative marking in defence exams?
faq.a: Yes. NDA: 1/3 per wrong answer. CDS: 1/3. AFCAT: 1/3. No negative marking in SSB, medical, or physical tests.

faq.q: What is the age limit for defence exams?
faq.a: NDA: 16.5–19.5 years. CDS: 19–25 years (varies by academy). AFCAT: 20–24 years (Flying), 20–26 (Ground Duty). Agniveer: 17.5–21 years. Age relaxations for SC/ST/OBC.

faq.q: Where do I find official defence notifications?
faq.a: joinindianarmy.nic.in (Army), joinindiannavy.gov.in (Navy), indianairforce.nic.in (Air Force), upsc.gov.in (NDA/CDS), afcat.cdac.in (AFCAT). SarkariJobs+ links the official PDF on every listing.
